headline: LocoMuJoCo：Mac 可跑的全身动作模仿基准
title_en: LocoMuJoCo: An Open Benchmark for Whole-Body Motion Imitation
tagline_en: An open-source MuJoCo benchmark for training humanoid, quadruped, and skeletal robots to imitate mocap motion.
summary_md:
**What it is.** LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark from Firas Al-Hafez, Davide Tateo, Oleg Kaidanov, Aditya Bhatt, Artur Zelik, Zhengyi Luo, and Jan Peters for imitation learning and reinforcement learning on whole-body control. Per the paper, it puts MuJoCo (CPU) and the MJX / MjWarp GPU backends under one API, and ships 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments. Each humanoid comes with a curated native motion-capture dataset, and the library can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1 motions onto its robots.

**Why it matters.** Whole-body imitation work is scattered across papers, each with its own robot model, motion set, and training code, which makes results hard to compare. LocoMuJoCo tries to fix that with a modular plug-in design: observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization are interchangeable, and compact JAX implementations of several RL and IL algorithms give JIT-compiled end-to-end training. A companion repo, loco-mujoco-real, covers sim-to-real deployment. It is MIT-licensed.

**Can you try it without a robot?** Yes, partly. MuJoCo's CPU backend runs on a Mac, so you can run the bundled examples and train a small policy on a quadruped or humanoid in simulation. The GPU-accelerated MJX / MjWarp path expects an NVIDIA setup and is best skipped on an Apple Silicon machine.

pick.title: LocoMuJoCo: A Comprehensive Imitation Learning Benchmark for Whole-Body Control
pick.one_liner: 一个开源基准库，让你在电脑模拟里训练人形、四足、骨骼机器人学全身动作模仿
pick.one_liner_en: An open-source benchmark library for training humanoid, quadruped and skeletal robots to imitate whole-body motion in simulation.
pick.how_to_try: Mac 上装好 MuJoCo CPU 后端，跑仓库自带示例，让四足或人形机器人学着模仿捕捉的动作数据；GPU 加速部分跳过。
pick.how_to_try_en: On Mac, install MuJoCo CPU backend and run the repo's example scripts to make a quadruped or humanoid imitate mocap data; skip the GPU backend.
pick.reason: 多本体、MIT 开源、Mac 可跑，是入门强化学习与模仿学习的好教材，但属于工程整合型基准，突破性有限。
red_flags: 发布时间和 arXiv 编号看起来异常，需核对真伪
主要价值是基准平台而非新方法，缺乏亮眼结果

top.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
top.one_liner: 一个新仿真基准，拆开测机器人的思考、操作和两者配合。
top.one_liner_en: A new simulated benchmark that separately tests robot thinking, acting, and combining both.
top.how_to_try: 先去看论文的 profile card（诊断卡片）和任务配置；要动手运行，需要装好仿真环境，具体方式取决于官方仓库和代码。
top.how_to_try_en: Read the profile cards and task configs first; running it on a Mac depends on the repo's sim setup, so check the code before trying.
top.reason: 把思考、执行和组合分开诊断，思路有价值；但只有仿真和诊断工具，开放程度一般，适合作为学习材料。
red_flags: 纯仿真基准，没有真实机器人验证
只公布部分结果和诊断工具，缺乏可复现的细节
论文编号和发布日期可疑，刊发真实性无法确认

top.title: nvidia/Alpamayo2-Edge
top.one_liner: 英伟达2B参数视觉语言动作模型，看车载摄像头画面直接输出驾驶轨迹和推理说明
top.one_liner_en: NVIDIA's 2B vision-language-action model that turns camera images into driving trajectories plus reasoning
top.how_to_try: Mac 跑不动，因为 BF16 需要约 5GB 显存，而且多相机输入要专门处理。可以看仓库里的 demo 和推理脚本，或者用云 GPU 跑单帧。
top.how_to_try_en: Mac can't run 2B BF16 multimodality; read inference code and demos, use cloud GPU for single-frame tests.
top.reason: 前沿 VLA 用于自动驾驶，权重和代码都开放，且配有推理说明；作为学习 VLA 与轨迹生成的范例很有价值，但普通 Mac 跑不动，输入格式也比较难啃。
red_flags: 多相机和自车运动历史输入复杂，单人极难复现
需要 NVIDIA DRIVE 平台才有完整部署体验
发布日期与 README 不一致，信息可疑

top.title: lerobot/droid_1.0.1
top.one_liner: 近10万条真实机械臂抓取操作视频与动作记录，开源可下载
top.one_liner_en: Nearly 100k real robot arm manipulation episodes with video, open and downloadable
top.how_to_try: Mac 上用 LeRobot 只下载小部分 episode，先可视化视频与动作，再试小模型训练；全量太大别下
top.how_to_try_en: On Mac, use LeRobot to download a few episodes only, visualize video+actions, then try a small training run; skip full dataset
top.reason: DROID 是真实场景大规模操作数据集，开放且生态好，适合入门模仿学习；但体量大，只能抽样玩。
red_flags: 约2700万帧全量数据极大，16GB Mac 无法完整容纳
无对应论文，动作质量与采集多样性需自行核实

top.title: emoPointer/supermimic_manipulation
top.one_liner: 用可微世界模型把任务回报反传，训练机械臂完成抓取放置任务
top.one_liner_en: Trains a simulated robot arm by backpropagating task reward through a learned world model
top.how_to_try: 需要 NVIDIA GPU 跑 mjlab（MuJoCo Warp）；Mac 上只能读代码和看视频，难训练
top.how_to_try_en: Needs an NVIDIA GPU for mjlab (MuJoCo Warp); on a Mac you can only read the code and watch clips, not train.
top.reason: 方法清晰、代码许可证宽松、任务视频直观，是理解世界模型+RL 的好材料，但纯仿真且需 GPU，新人只能读不能玩。
red_flags: 仅在仿真、低维状态输入，没有真实机器人验证
训练需 GPU 和数小时到十几小时，无硬件新人难复现
Drawer 任务不同 checkpoint 成功率波动大（24%~90%）

trend.name_en: World Action Models for VLA Post-training
trend.one_liner: 用可预测未来的世界模型当老师，代替仿真器来训练和纠错机器人动作策略
trend.one_liner_en: Using a learned world model that predicts the future as a stand-in for a simulator to train and correct robot policies.

evidence.title: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
evidence.one_liner_en: Post-trains a humanoid whole-body VLA with RL inside a video world model instead of a simulator

evidence.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
evidence.one_liner_en: A robot policy teaches itself actions by peeking at future video as a teacher.

evidence.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
evidence.one_liner_en: A robot policy that predicts only what changes in the scene, cutting compute while improving success.

evidence.title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
evidence.one_liner_en: Turns an arm robot model into a language-guided quadruped that manipulates with one front leg

evidence.one_liner_en: Trains a simulated robot arm by backpropagating task reward through a learned world model
